content.text:
- composer.json
          - composer.lock
          - "**/*.{php,install,module}"

composer validate:
  extends: .composer
  stage: validate
  interruptible: true
  script:
    - composer validate --ansi --check-lock
  rules:
    - !reference [.validate_rules_php, rules]

phplint:
  extends:
    - .composer
    - .validate_rules_php
  stage: validate
  interruptible: true
  script:
    - composer install --ansi --no-interaction
    - vendor/bin/parallel-lint --show-deprecated -e php,module,install,profile,theme --gitlab profile > gl-code-quality-report.json
  artifacts:
    name: "$CI_JOB_NAME artifacts from $CI_PROJECT_NAME on $CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG"
    when: always
    expire_in: 6 mos
    reports:
      codequality: [gl-code-quality-report.json]

🧹 PHP Coding standards (PHPCS):
  extends:
    - .composer
    - .validate_rules_php
  needs:
    - phplint
  stage: validate
  interruptible: true
  allow_failure: true
  script:
    - composer install --ansi --no-interaction
    - composer run php:cs -- --report-junit=junit.xml --report-\\Micheh\\PhpCodeSniffer\\Report\\Gitlab=phpcs-quality-report.json --report-full --report-summary --report-source || EXIT_CODE=$?
    - if [[ $EXIT_CODE == "" ]]; then echo "There are no PHPCS coding standards errors or warnings"; fi
    - echo "Exiting with EXIT_CODE=$EXIT_CODE" && exit $EXIT_CODE
  artifacts:
    name: "$CI_JOB_NAME artifacts from $CI_PROJECT_NAME on $CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG"
    when: always
    expire_in: 6 mos
    reports:
      codequality: [phpcs-quality-report.json]
      junit: [junit.xml]

🧹 PHP Static Analysis (phpstan) :
  extends:
    - .composer
    - .validate_rules_php
  needs:
    - phplint
  stage: validate
  interruptible: true
  script:
    - composer install --ansi --no-interaction
    - php $CI_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/bin/phpstan --configuration=phpstan.ci.neon --no-progress --error-format=junit analyze > $CI_PROJECT_DIR/junit.xml || true
    - php $CI_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/bin/phpstan --configuration=phpstan.ci.neon --no-progress --error-format=gitlab analyze > $CI_PROJECT_DIR/phpstan-quality-report.json || true
    - php $CI_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/bin/phpstan --configuration=phpstan.ci.neon --no-progress analyze || EXIT_CODE=$?
    - exit $EXIT_CODE
  cache:
    - key: phpstan
      paths:
        - .phpstancache
      when: always
  artifacts:
    name: "$CI_JOB_NAME artifacts from $CI_PROJECT_NAME on $CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG"
    when: always
    expire_in: 6 mos
    reports:
      codequality: [phpstan-quality-report.json]
      junit: [junit.xml]

rector dry-run:
  extends:
    - .composer
    - .validate_rules_php
  needs:
    - phplint
  stage: validate
  interruptible: true
